attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Psychologist Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved programs; pre-approved providers: APA, Canadian Psychological Association, ND or any state/provincial psychological or behavior-analytic association or regulatory body, ABAI, BACB, AAIDD, Northland Association for Behavior Analysis, AMA and ASWB ACE (for content within NDCC 43-32 practice)
rules.audit_note: Signed CE statement listing activities at the end of each cycle; about 10% randomly selected for verification; keep documentation for two years after submission.

topics.who: All licensees: professional ethics, law, or jurisprudence
Licensees supervising psychology residents or registered applied behavior analysts

rules.notes: Two-year reporting cycle starting Nov 1 of the year of ND licensure; CE report due Nov 15 after the cycle. License fee renews annually (application by Nov 15 for Jan 1). Formal programs need real-time interaction; writing/speaking max 20, online/recorded/reading max 20 credits per cycle. Also applies to I-O psychologists.
rules.rule_quote: Application for continuing education credits must be made on the form provided by the board and must include evidence of completion of at least forty credits of continuing education completed over the two-year period.
